description: List SmartTests whose latest executions still need human verification before they earn a verified badge (testId, testName, filePath, scenarioId / scenarioOrdinalId / scenarioTitle, verificationStatus NOT_VERIFIED or VERIFIED_STALE, reportedAtMillis, workflowExecutionId). Optional userId narrows to tests authored for that user (defaults to the OAuth token's user); optional limit. Use after writing E2E tests to prompt the user to verify the executions.
name: list-tests-awaiting-verification
title: List Tests Awaiting Verification
